### 5v-rail-application

<EvidenceAnchor id="cov-ptc2-rail-application" />

- **Coverage ID:** `cov-ptc2-rail-application`
- **Status:** COVERED

**Reason:** Ihold leaves a 0.6A margin above the +5V/0.5A rail current budget and Vmax leaves a 28V margin above the +5V nominal rail voltage; both margins are large and healthy, so PTC2 passes its rail-application check without qualification.

**Facts in this domain:**

- [`fact-ptc2-ihold-margin`](#fact-ptc2-ihold-margin)
- [`fact-ptc2-vmax-margin`](#fact-ptc2-vmax-margin)

### ambient-derating-fault-current-and-cycling

<EvidenceAnchor id="cov-ptc2-fault" />

- **Coverage ID:** `cov-ptc2-fault`
- **Status:** OPEN

**Reason:** The single-page Techfuse specification sheet does not tabulate ambient-temperature-derated hold current or environmental/aging test data (unlike the RUILON and BHFUSE datasheets for PTC1/PTC3), and no board-b generator spec exists yet to bound upstream fault current/energy, in-enclosure ambient, or trip-cycling history at PTC2.

**Facts in this domain:** none are recorded against it.

**Blocked by:** no blocking fact is recorded. What is missing has not been reduced to a specific recorded fact, so the reason above is the whole of what is known.
